nodes.label: Spacing and layout (DESIGN.md)
nodes.community_name: DESIGN.md: Design System: Alan Sahlan portfolio
nodes.excerpt:
All page and component padding follows the 4/8px scale. Use shared tokens for repeated spacing. The current fixed space tokens are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, and 64px; larger fluid gaps use the formulas below. Other scale values may be local lengths without adding unused root tokens.

| Role | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Page width | `min(100% - var(--gutter) * 2, 1440px)`, centered |
| Gutter | `round(nearest, clamp(24px, 5vw, 80px), 8px)` |
| Related text | 12–16px |
| Content gap | `--content-gap`, 24px |
| Group gap | `--content-group-gap`, 32px |
| Section gap | `--section-space`, `round(nearest, clamp(48px, 5vw, 80px), 8px)` |
| Section heading | `--section-heading-gap`, `round(nearest, clamp(24px, 2vw, 32px), 8px)` |
| Source group | One 48px gap after the conclusion/disclosure |
| Ruled reading group | 32px padding |
| Expanded case notes | 24px top and 32px bottom |
| Page ending | 48px before the footer |

A continuous case-study section owns one leading gap. Clear its last child's trailing margin and avoid stacking equal trailing/leading padding. Keep captions beside their figures. Mixed content explicitly owns sibling gaps, including 32px after a results list's final divider. Fluid gutters and section spacing round to 8px at intermediate widths.

Home's desktop hero uses a 1.15fr/1fr split; the phone hero becomes a compact single column. The 4:5 phone character frame is capped at 152px. About pairs introduction/portrait, capabilities/experience, and learning/comparison before a compact trivia section. Those pairs stack at 760px and also respond to their text-relative container width. Contact stacks below 950px; name/email stack below 600px.

Selected work has four ruled rows. The same 3:1 cover moves from a right-hand thumbnail to a full preview below its titl

nodes.label: Interaction (docs/about.md)
nodes.community_name: DESIGN.md: Design System: Alan Sahlan portfolio
nodes.excerpt:
Inline research/wireframing/prototyping triggers reveal sketches by hover, focus, or tap. Click pins a preview; Escape, repeat activation, or outside input dismisses it. Targets are at least 44px. Measured previews fit below the compact header; an inner scroller keeps long explanations keyboard-readable without breaking the hover bridge.

The portrait greeting supports keyboard/touch and Escape even when mouse activation leaves focus unchanged. The save comparison keeps its state when Static / Motion changes; reduced motion and forced colors take precedence. Label and live feedback communicate state independently of animation.

The compact trivia deck supports free bounded dragging, sideways swipes, answer reveal/hide, and Next question. Vertical movement returns the same card. A drag suppresses accidental answer clicks; cancellation, Escape, preference, and viewport changes restore the card. Active content determines height. Tall/enlarged content retains native scroll access. Keyboard/preferences settle movement immediately. No-JavaScript and print readers retain all facts.

Use [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md) for shared spacing, surfaces, typography, and card geometry. Paired sections stack at the viewport and text-relative container breakpoints. The portrait's responsive source sizes match its 440px cap. [Quality checks](quality.md) owns current verification.

nodes.label: Header and navigation (DESIGN.md)
nodes.community_name: DESIGN.md: Design System: Alan Sahlan portfolio
nodes.excerpt:
Keep Home, About, Contact, and Download resume in full navigation at the top. Resume actions use a PDF cue and the verified local file. Primary links have 44px minimum targets, current-page indication, and visible focus.

Compact navigation enters above 96px scroll and returns below 48px, deferring changes during header focus or an open menu. Its fixed strip reserves safe-area space. The theme switch sits immediately left of Menu and dialog Close with a .75rem gap. The menu scrolls vertically and contains focus, supports Escape, makes the background inert, and restores focus/scroll correctly.

The menu's five panels move vertically. Page navigation uses five sharp horizontal bands, a 610ms combined budget, 30ms stagger, and `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`. Keyboard activation bypasses the curtain; reduced motion uses an 80ms fade; forced colors navigates immediately. Gallery entry requests the shared-image effect independently. [Navigation](docs/page-transitions.md) owns the complete lifecycle.

Lead with a short project introduction and three facts. Explain decisions once beside original screens. Put research methods, factual build notes, recordings, and extra screens in native ruled disclosures with 44px summary targets. Preserve source links and intrinsic image dimensions.

`ProjectScreen` displays originals or compressed SVG previews and links to the original. PawFriend's media sequence uses named native links, progress, keyboard access, and a focus-only Skip. Wide cropped details retain native panning on phones and complete-original disclosures. Original rasters and SVG photograph fills retain source-resolution limits.

Munchpal's Residents / Volunteers selector uses native radios, the 250ms selection duration, and `cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1)` over its longer travel. A clipped active-label layer keeps text aligned; keyboard and preferences settle immediately. Both flows remain available without JavaScript and print includes both.

nodes.label: Stationary targets and motion (DESIGN.md)
nodes.community_name: DESIGN.md: Design System: Alan Sahlan portfolio
nodes.excerpt:
Magnetic feedback moves separate visual children, capped at 5px for text, 6px for gallery title/arrow, and 8px for controls. Its spring is stiffness 100, damping 12, mass .8. `ControlVisual` presses painted button children to .97 with the shared 320/30 spring. Semantic targets, focus outlines, and click coordinates stay still. Reset movement on cancellation, focus, hidden documents, disabled state, and relevant preference changes.

The decorative cursor is a 7px dot at the actual fine-pointer position. Over imagery it expands to a 72px difference-blend disc; actionable imagery gets a separate arrow. Text selection, fields, disclosures, media controls, and local-feedback actions keep appropriate native behavior. Touch, reduced motion, and forced colors use the native cursor. See [pointer behavior](docs/pointer-interactions.md).

Home reveals later content once with a 24px rise and 500ms fade. Initially visible content, restored positions, keyboard access, direct sections, no JavaScript, and motion/color preferences remain immediately readable. The remaining soft About-detail entrance is opacity-only. Pages without matching entrance targets skip observer/listener setup.

nodes.label: Delivery and recovery (docs/contact-page.md)
nodes.community_name: DESIGN.md: Design System: Alan Sahlan portfolio
nodes.excerpt:
Prepare an email leads to Open email draft. Name, email, and message are required; topic is optional. The encoded `mailto:` opens the visitor's email app, where they send the message. The website sends no email itself. Native form validation and mailto behavior remain without JavaScript.

Copy email uses the verified address. Copy message assembles the current subject/message, requiring message text but no name/email validation. Pending clipboard writes disable their controls. Editing invalidates a pending response so stale completion cannot replace the new draft's feedback.

Clipboard denial/unavailability reveals labelled read-only text, focuses/selects it for manual copying, and preserves the editable draft. Prepared drafts retain a direct retry link. Optional session storage keeps the draft within the current tab when permitted; storage failures leave the form usable.

nodes.label: Pointer and history navigation (docs/page-transitions.md)

Five sharp horizontal cobalt bands cover, then uncover the destination. The combined animation budget is 610ms, with a 30ms stagger and `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`. Forward routes sweep left-to-right; Home/Back use the opposite direction. Contact-to-About also returns right-to-left. Completion promises gate route switching under full cover; repeated input retargets current motion/destination. Prefetch starts with cover. Open-menu navigation releases its lock under coverage. Back/Forward restore existing history state without adding entries.

Home goes to the root top and heading, clearing pending project-return intent. Identical idle destinations preserve the history entry. Same-page sections retain native scrolling. Direct visits and reloads do not play a route curtain. [Project entry](project-entry.md) owns gallery snapshots separately.

The compact header enters above 96px scroll and returns below 48px, deferring changes while focused or while the menu is mounted. A delayed-route loading/recovery design remains open in [release work](quality.md#remaining-release-work).

The 7px dot follows the actual pointer in the next rendered frame. Image hover expands a 72px difference-blend disc; actionable images get a separate arrow. Position does not use a trailing easing loop. Size transitions are time-based; leaving imagery immediately restores the dot.

Text selection, editable controls, disclosures, media controls, and local-feedback actions preserve appropriate native semantics. Selection/editing stop displacement. Route/menu changes reset magnetic state and re-evaluate the cursor at the current coordinates. Geometry invalidation and pointer input batch by animation frame. Window exit, hidden documents, input/preference changes, and cleanup reset listeners/observers/frames.

Hide the native cursor only after its replacement is positioned and visible. Touch, reduced motion, and forced colors use the native cursor. Effects carry no required content and intercept no pointer events. See [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md) for shared feedback and [quality checks](quality.md) for coverage.

nodes.label: Action contracts (docs/pointer-interactions.md)
nodes.excerpt:
Use `data-magnet` with separate `data-magnet-part` visual children for shared magnetic response. Text movement caps at 5px, gallery title/arrow at 6px, and controls at 8px. The spring uses stiffness 100, damping 12, mass .8, rest delta .05, and rest speed .5. Native link/button targets remain stationary. Nested magnets must not move one target twice.

Locally managed actions use `data-pointer-feedback="local"`: theme/interactive controls, disclosures, image inspection, media playback, form controls, and other components with their own stable feedback. Disabled/inert actions remain excluded. The former queried magnet-disabled attribute has no current contract.

The browser action-inventory tests cover header/menu/footer, gallery, case links and images, contact, About, recordings, and opener controls. Update the real inventory when adding actions; avoid a fixed obsolete action count.
